title: Kirby Problem 1.46
exact_target: Determine topological slice genera of torus knots and the effectiveness of ribbon and slice obstructions for two-bridge knots, including the possible size of the smooth versus topological genus gap.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 2705 (KP-1.46). CC BY 4.0.
